eligibility_categories.eligibility_requirements: 10 years residency; Minimum capital of AED 2 million; letter from an approved investment fund confirming a deposit of at least 2,000,000 AED, or valid commercial/industrial licence with company incorporation documents showing capital of at least 2,000,000 AED
5 years residency; property ownership proving ownership of one or more properties with combined value >= 2,000,000 AED (without loans); proof of residence in the UAE
5 years residency; proof of innovative or technical projects; documents proving project value (auditor's letter proving project value >= 500,000 AED); letter from an accredited business incubator

eligibility_categories.category_name: Those with exceptional talent or rare specialisations
eligibility_categories.eligibility_requirements: 10 years residency; doctors, scientists, inventors, creatives, executives (salary >= 50,000 AED/mo & 5 yrs exp), athletes, PhD holders
High school achievers (95%+) for 5 years; top university students (GPA >= 3.8) for 10 years

application_steps: Check eligibility online via ICP smart services portal
Apply through ICP portal or GDRFA Dubai portal
Creatives can apply for recommendation via Ministry of Culture

data.direct_answer: Indian nationals who are not eligible for visa on arrival or visa-free entry must apply for a tourist visa through a UAE-based airline, a licensed travel agent, or a hotel. You can also apply online via the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security (ICP) or GDRFA Dubai.
eligibility_criteria: Sponsorship via airline, licensed travel agent, or hotel, or directly via ICP/GDRFA online portals
For 5-year multiple-entry tourist visa: bank balance of 4,000 USD or equivalent in the last 6 months
Valid health insurance applicable in the UAE for at least 180 days
application_steps: Choose channel: UAE-based airline, licensed travel agent, hotel, ICP smart services portal, or GDRFA Dubai portal
Submit passport copy, return flight ticket, and hotel booking
Receive electronic tourist visa via email
data.fees_or_validity: 5-year multiple entry visa (90 days per visit) or 30/60-day single/multiple entry tourist visa

data.direct_answer: Student visas are issued for accredited university or college students in the UAE. Universities facilitate the application process directly.
eligibility_criteria: Submit an official certificate issued by the university or institute specifying the study duration
Can be sponsored by a parent who is a UAE resident or directly by the accredited university/college
Meet general residence visa medical fitness and Emirates ID requirements
application_steps: Obtain admission and study duration certificate from accredited university
University submits visa application to ICP or GDRFA on student's behalf
Complete medical fitness test and Emirates ID biometric registration
data.processing_time: Varies by institution; typically processed within 2 to 4 weeks upon submission of all required documents.
